recommendation: Keep this audit commit. Revisit only if FHIR-56309 or a future work-group decision explicitly approves an Endpoint reference or mapping change for Subscription.endpoint.
issue_request: FHIR-10190 asked to replace the Subscription channel backbone with a reference to the Endpoint resource and to review subscription channel type terminology/codes. It was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: do not replace the channel, because Subscription only partially overlaps Endpoint and includes other channel-specific details; declare the relationship as a mapping.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-10190 implementation commit was found. Historical Subscription source after the 2016 vote continued to use Subscription.channel.endpoint URL wording, and the current R5/R6 source is a later redesign that removed the old channel backbone while retaining a URL-valued Subscription.endpoint.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps both Subscription and Endpoint active. Current Subscription defines channelType plus endpoint url; current framework narrative uses Endpoint as an abstract notification receiver role. Later applied FHIR-47344 clarified Subscription.endpoint as a channel-specific URL, while FHIR-56309 is a newer Submitted/unresolved request to change the element to reference Endpoint.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A source edit to add an Endpoint reference or mapping would be speculative because the final seed decision rejected replacement and later final R6 context preserves the URL model.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 clarification for Subscription.endpoint retained and clarified channel-specific URL semantics in the current source.
Submitted unresolved R6 proposal to make Subscription.endpoint reference Endpoint; not final enough to apply here.
Earlier Published issue renamed Subscription.channel.url to Subscription.channel.endpoint, providing the endpoint terminology that FHIR-10190 later revisited.

evidence_items.summary: Published FHIR-I issue resolved Not Persuasive with Modification: do not replace Subscription channel with Endpoint, because the models only partially overlap; declare the relationship as a mapping.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed decision and rules out changing Subscription.endpoint to Reference(Endpoint) based on this issue alone.

evidence_items.summary: The resources section includes active endpoint=Endpoint and subscription=Subscription entries.
evidence_items.learned: Both relevant resource source folders are in the current FHIR build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Current Subscription defines channelType as Coding and endpoint as url with the definition 'Channel-specific URL that describes where notifications are sent.'
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current resource source already reflects a URL-based endpoint rather than a Reference(Endpoint).

evidence_items.summary: The Subscriptions Framework defines Endpoint as the notification-receiving portion of the client and says Subscription describes the channel and endpoint used for notifications.
evidence_items.learned: Current narrative frames endpoint as a role in the subscription flow, not as a required Endpoint resource reference.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-47344 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and commit ac3fd3079e changed Subscription.endpoint's short, definition, and comment to channel-specific URL wording.
evidence_items.learned: A later final decision intentionally retained and clarified the current URL model.

evidence_items.summary: Submitted/unresolved R6 request to change Subscription.endpoint from url to Endpoint reference for endpoint change management.
evidence_items.learned: The Endpoint-reference change is a live unresolved proposal, not an approved correction to make under FHIR-10190.

evidence_items.summary: No explicit FHIR-10190 implementation commit was found; historical spreadsheets kept Subscription.channel.endpoint URL wording; current active source uses Subscription.endpoint url and no Endpoint reference mapping.
